report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Valley View Ranches (report date June 25, 2026)

sources_described: Groundwater: Well 02 is located near the intersection of Fitzgerald and Green Valley Drive.

https://sdwis.waterboards.ca.gov/PDWW/JSP/WaterSystemDetail.jsp?tinwsys_is_number=4345&tinwsys_st_code=CA&wsnumber=CA4300996 -> system page, Consumer Confidence Reports menu

violations: Table 4 (page 3): the Nitrate (mg/L) row prints a Max of '76*'. The report's legend states 'Any violation of an AL, MCL, MRDL, or TT is asterisked. Additional information regarding the violation is provided later in this report', but no violation explanation, table or notice appears anywhere in the report; the Level Detected for the same row is 4.11 mg/L.
extraction_notes: Text-layer PDF read with pdftotext -layout; page numbers are PDF pages and match the report's 'Page x of 4' footers. Tables 4 and 5 have Min/Max columns instead of a range; they are blank for every row except the nitrate Max '76*' (recorded as range_high 76 with the asterisk noted; this cannot be reconciled with the 4.11 mg/L level detected and the report gives no explanation). Nitrate appears twice (as N with MCL 10, and 'as NO3' with MCL 45) with the identical value 4.11 printed in both rows. Hardness appears in Table 3 and again in Table 6. The report states 'Valley View Ranches did not operate under a variance or exemption in 2025' and contains no violations table.
